statements.statement: ChauffeurNet exemplifies an approach using mid-level input representations and recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to output driving trajectories for control.
The model includes components such as FeatureNet, AgentRNN, PerceptionRNN, and a co-trained road mask prediction network.
Mid-level representations enable training on both real and simulated data and facilitate closed-loop simulation testing prior to real-world deployment.
The recurrent feedback mechanism iteratively refines predictions during training.
